prompt: The vendor list table on /vendors page has inconsistent column alignment - currency columns aren't right-aligned, and the table header styling looks off compared to other tables in the app. Fix it to match the design system table-hd pattern.

assertions.text: Proper table structure with thead and tbody
assertions.evidence: Uses semantic table structure with proper thead/tbody separation
Opening Balance column uses text-right class and font-mono

assertions.text: Table headers use consistent styling (bg-slate-50/50, uppercase, tracking-wider)
assertions.evidence: Headers have bg-slate-50/50, uppercase, tracking-wider, font-bold
Uses border-collapse class and consistent px-6 py-4 padding
